title: Path subagent output envelope (engage-codex)
description: Wraps the path's structured narrative artefact, paradigm + artefact-type self-declaration, ≤200-word rationale, and 'what would change this' bullets. The artefact field is one of the five artefact-schema shapes; the primary agent validates it against the schema named in artefactType.

artefact.description: Structured narrative artefact conforming to the schema named by artefactType. Pure-prose returns (missing artefact, or artefact with no structured payload) fail validation.

rationale.description: ≤200 words of narrative rationale. Hard-cap on character count enforces the word limit approximately.
